mister.zh: 先生（稱呼，常縮寫為 Mr.）

ex.en: Why is there a Miss Italy but no Mister Italy?
ex.zh: 為什麼有義大利小姐，卻沒有義大利先生？

ex.en: Excuse me, mister, you dropped your wallet.
ex.zh: 先生，不好意思，你的皮夾掉了。

ex.en: Hey, mister, is this seat taken?
ex.zh: 先生，請問這個位子有人坐嗎？

ex.en: The hotel room has a mini fridge.
ex.zh: 飯店房間裡有一台迷你冰箱。

ex.en: We had a mini meeting before lunch.
ex.zh: 我們午餐前開了個簡短的小會議。

ex.en: She wore a black mini to the party.
ex.zh: 她穿了一件黑色迷你裙去派對。

ex.en: He drives an old red Mini.
ex.zh: 他開一輛舊的紅色小車。

ex.en: Heads up! The server will shut down at midnight.
ex.zh: 注意！伺服器將在午夜關機。

ex.en: It was almost midnight when we got home.
ex.zh: 我們到家時已經快半夜了。

ex.en: He gave me a ring at midnight.
ex.zh: 他半夜打電話給我。

ex.en: We need to minimize costs this year.
ex.zh: 今年我們需要把成本降到最低。

ex.en: Back up your files to minimize the risk of data loss.
ex.zh: 備份檔案以降低資料遺失的風險。

ex.en: Minimize the window and open the file.
ex.zh: 把視窗縮到最小，然後打開檔案。

ex.en: Click here to minimize the browser.
ex.zh: 點這裡把瀏覽器縮到最小。

ex.en: For some reason the microphone didn't work earlier.
ex.zh: 不知道為什麼，剛才麥克風不能用。

ex.en: Tom put his hand over the microphone.
ex.zh: 湯姆把手放在麥克風上。

ex.en: Please speak into the microphone.
ex.zh: 請對著麥克風說話。

ex.en: This microscope magnifies objects by 100 times.
ex.zh: 這台顯微鏡可以把物體放大一百倍。

ex.en: Do you know the difference between a microscope and a telescope?
ex.zh: 你知道顯微鏡和望遠鏡有什麼不同嗎？

ex.en: Do you know who invented the microscope?
ex.zh: 你知道顯微鏡是誰發明的嗎？

microscope.zh: under the microscope：受到嚴格檢視

ex.en: The company's finances are under the microscope.
ex.zh: 這家公司的財務正受到嚴格檢視。

ex.en: Every decision he makes is under the microscope.
ex.zh: 他做的每個決定都被放大檢視。

ex.en: I didn't want to mislead anyone.
ex.zh: 我不想誤導任何人。

ex.en: He misled her.
ex.zh: 他誤導了她。

ex.en: It's a misleading title.
ex.zh: 這個標題有誤導性。

misplace.zh: 放錯地方（以致一時找不到）

ex.en: I seem to have misplaced my keys.
ex.zh: 我好像把鑰匙放錯地方了。

ex.en: Tom misplaced the contract and spent an hour looking for it.
ex.zh: 湯姆把合約亂放，花了一個小時才找到。

ex.en: Water, forests, and minerals are important natural resources.
ex.zh: 水、森林和礦物都是重要的天然資源。

ex.en: That country is rich in mineral resources.
ex.zh: 那個國家擁有豐富的礦產資源。

ex.en: A mine is where you find precious minerals.
ex.zh: 礦坑是可以找到珍貴礦物的地方。

ex.en: I like to drink natural mineral water.
ex.zh: 我喜歡喝天然礦泉水。

ex.en: Can I have a bottle of mineral water?
ex.zh: 可以給我一瓶礦泉水嗎？

ex.en: Generally speaking, the climate of Japan is mild.
ex.zh: 整體來說，日本的氣候很溫和。

ex.en: We had a mild winter last year.
ex.zh: 去年冬天很溫和。

ex.en: This country has a mild climate.
ex.zh: 這個國家氣候溫和。

ex.en: Taiwanese food is milder than Indian food.
ex.zh: 台灣菜的口味比印度菜清淡。

ex.en: Can I have the mild curry, please?
ex.zh: 請給我不辣的咖哩好嗎？

ex.en: I have a mild headache.
ex.zh: 我有點輕微頭痛。

ex.en: Tom had a mild case of the flu.
ex.zh: 湯姆得了輕微的流感。

ex.en: The car has low mileage.
ex.zh: 這輛車的里程數很低。

ex.en: What's the mileage on this car?
ex.zh: 這輛車跑了多少里程？

mileage.zh: 油耗（每加侖可行駛的英里數）

ex.en: This car gets good mileage.
ex.zh: 這輛車很省油。

ex.en: Hybrid cars get better mileage.
ex.zh: 油電混合車比較省油。

ex.en: It is about time we bought a new microwave oven.
ex.zh: 我們該買一台新的微波爐了。

ex.en: Tom doesn't have a microwave oven.
ex.zh: 湯姆沒有微波爐。

ex.en: Heat the soup in the microwave for two minutes.
ex.zh: 把湯放進微波爐加熱兩分鐘。

ex.en: I usually microwave my lunch at the office.
ex.zh: 我通常在辦公室用微波爐熱午餐。

ex.en: Don't microwave food in metal containers.
ex.zh: 不要用金屬容器微波食物。

ex.en: The witness misidentified the suspect.
ex.zh: 目擊者認錯了嫌犯。

ex.en: The app sometimes misidentifies plants in photos.
ex.zh: 這個 App 有時會認錯照片裡的植物。

mid.zh: 中間的、中期的（多作字首，如 mid-July 七月中旬）

ex.en: The prefix "mid" means "middle," as in mid-July.
ex.zh: 字首「mid」表示「中間」，例如 mid-July（七月中旬）。

ex.en: Use "mid" with months, like mid-May or mid-June.
ex.zh: 「mid」可以和月份連用，例如 mid-May、mid-June。

ex.en: The Ministry of Education announced new rules.
ex.zh: 教育部宣布了新規定。

ex.en: He works at the Ministry of Finance.
ex.zh: 他在財政部工作。

ex.en: How many is nine minus six?
ex.zh: 九減六等於多少？

ex.en: Eight minus four is four.
ex.zh: 八減四等於四。

ex.en: Seven minus two is five.
ex.zh: 七減二等於五。

ex.en: The temperature dropped to minus ten degrees.
ex.zh: 氣溫降到零下十度。

ex.en: He got an A minus on the test.
ex.zh: 他這次考試拿了 A-。

ex.en: They unveiled new ballistic missiles.
ex.zh: 他們發表了新型彈道飛彈。

ex.en: The country tested a new missile last week.
ex.zh: 該國上週試射了一枚新飛彈。

ex.en: The union took a militant stance in the negotiations.
ex.zh: 工會在談判中採取強硬立場。

ex.en: She is a militant supporter of animal rights.
ex.zh: 她是激進的動物權利支持者。

ex.en: The city has a large number of migrants from rural areas.
ex.zh: 這座城市有很多來自鄉村的移居者。

ex.en: Many migrant workers in Taiwan come from Southeast Asia.
ex.zh: 台灣有許多移工來自東南亞。

ex.en: The village formed a militia to protect itself.
ex.zh: 村民組成民兵自衛。

ex.en: The militia was disbanded after the war.
ex.zh: 戰後民兵組織就解散了。

ex.en: The damage to the car was minimal.
ex.zh: 車子的損傷很輕微。

ex.en: This printer requires minimal maintenance.
ex.zh: 這台印表機幾乎不需要保養。

ex.en: The project was completed at minimal cost.
ex.zh: 這個專案以最低的成本完成。

ex.en: My grandfather worked in a paper mill.
ex.zh: 我爺爺以前在造紙廠工作。

ex.en: The old mill by the river is now a museum.
ex.zh: 河邊那座老磨坊現在是博物館。

ex.en: Pass me the pepper mill, please.
ex.zh: 請把胡椒研磨罐遞給我。

ex.en: This coffee mill is easy to clean.
ex.zh: 這台咖啡磨豆機很好清洗。

ex.en: Bird migration happens every autumn.
ex.zh: 每年秋天都會有候鳥遷徙。

ex.en: Migration from rural areas to cities is increasing.
ex.zh: 從鄉村移居到城市的人越來越多。

ex.en: The data migration took two weekends.
ex.zh: 資料移轉花了兩個週末。

ex.en: We are planning a migration to the cloud.
ex.zh: 我們正在規劃把系統移轉到雲端。

ex.en: We need to look at the problem on a micro level.
ex.zh: 我們需要從微觀層面來看這個問題。

ex.en: The bank offers loans to micro businesses.
ex.zh: 這家銀行提供微型企業貸款。

ex.en: Please don't misunderstand me.
ex.zh: 請不要誤會我的意思。

ex.en: Tom speaks French so badly that he's often misunderstood.
ex.zh: 湯姆法文說得很差，常常被人誤會。

ex.en: Anything that can be misunderstood will be.
ex.zh: 凡是可能被誤解的，就一定會被誤解。

ex.en: This case might not get resolved for a while.
ex.zh: 這個案子可能短時間內解決不了。

ex.en: She was worried that she might miss the train.
ex.zh: 她擔心自己可能會趕不上火車。

ex.en: Academic fraud is more common than you might think.
ex.zh: 學術造假比你想像的還普遍。

ex.en: Since you are here, we might as well begin.
ex.zh: 既然你來了，我們不如就開始吧。

ex.en: It's raining, so we might as well stay home.
ex.zh: 在下雨，我們不如待在家吧。

ex.en: Would you mind my staying here for some time?
ex.zh: 你介意我在這裡待一會兒嗎？

ex.en: Do you mind if I turn off the light?
ex.zh: 你介意我把燈關掉嗎？

ex.en: I don't mind being criticized when I am wrong.
ex.zh: 我說錯時被批評，我並不介意。

ex.en: I can't get the song out of my mind.
ex.zh: 那首歌一直在我腦海裡揮之不去。

ex.en: She has a sharp mind.
ex.zh: 她頭腦很敏銳。

ex.en: Whatever he may say, I won't change my mind.
ex.zh: 無論他說什麼，我都不會改變主意。

ex.en: Tom changed his mind about the trip.
ex.zh: Tom 對這趟旅行改變了主意。

ex.en: Please keep in mind that the office closes at five.
ex.zh: 請記得辦公室五點就關門。

ex.en: Bear in mind that prices may change.
ex.zh: 請記住價格可能會變動。

ex.en: Will you listen to me for a few minutes?
ex.zh: 你願意聽我說幾分鐘嗎？

ex.en: I think we had better wait another thirty minutes.
ex.zh: 我想我們最好再等三十分鐘。

ex.en: The new secretary types about 70 words per minute.
ex.zh: 新來的秘書每分鐘大約打七十個字。

ex.en: Wait a minute, please.
ex.zh: 請稍等一下。

ex.en: Do you have a minute?
ex.zh: 你有空一下嗎？

ex.en: Amy took the minutes at the meeting.
ex.zh: Amy 在會議上負責做會議紀錄。

ex.en: Please send the minutes to everyone.
ex.zh: 請把會議紀錄寄給大家。

ex.en: The military power of this country is very advanced.
ex.zh: 這個國家的軍事力量非常先進。

ex.en: There is a military base near here.
ex.zh: 這附近有一個軍事基地。

ex.en: Every male Algerian citizen must do military service.
ex.zh: 每位阿爾及利亞男性公民都必須服兵役。

ex.en: The family was highly doubtful of the statement from the military.
ex.zh: 家屬對軍方的說法高度存疑。

ex.en: He joined the military after high school.
ex.zh: 他高中畢業後就從軍了。

ex.en: The town is two miles away from the coast.
ex.zh: 那個小鎮離海岸兩英里。

ex.en: My house is only a mile from here.
ex.zh: 我家離這裡只有一英里。

ex.en: A mile is equal to about 1,600 meters.
ex.zh: 一英里大約是一千六百公尺。

ex.en: The library is in the middle of the city.
ex.zh: 圖書館位於市中心。

ex.en: A truck was standing in the middle of the road.
ex.zh: 路中間停著一輛卡車。

ex.en: The church is in the middle of the village.
ex.zh: 教堂位在村子的中央。

middle.zh: in the middle of：正在……當中

ex.en: My PC is in the middle of an update.
ex.zh: 我的電腦正在更新。

ex.en: Sorry, I'm in the middle of a meeting.
ex.zh: 抱歉，我正在開會。

ex.en: She is the middle child of three.
ex.zh: 她是三個孩子中排行中間的。

ex.en: He sat in the middle row.
ex.zh: 他坐在中間那一排。

ex.en: Your camera is only half the size of mine.
ex.zh: 你的照相機只有我那臺的一半大小。

ex.en: She has a view that is different from mine.
ex.zh: 她的看法和我的不同。

ex.en: Your plan is very good, but mine is better.
ex.zh: 你們的計畫很好，但我的更好。

ex.en: His father worked in a coal mine.
ex.zh: 他父親在煤礦工作。

ex.en: The old gold mine is now a museum.
ex.zh: 那座老金礦現在是一座博物館。

ex.en: If you mix blue and red, you'll get purple.
ex.zh: 藍色和紅色混在一起就會變成紫色。

ex.en: Add water and mix to a firm dough.
ex.zh: 加水攪拌成結實的麵團。

ex.en: I don't like to mix business with pleasure.
ex.zh: 我不喜歡把工作和玩樂混在一起。

ex.en: She frequently gets sugar and salt mixed up.
ex.zh: 她常把糖和鹽搞混。

ex.en: I always mix up their names.
ex.zh: 我總是搞混他們的名字。

ex.en: I have mixed feelings about this.
ex.zh: 我對這件事心情很複雜。

ex.en: The movie got mixed reviews.
ex.zh: 這部電影的評價褒貶不一。

ex.en: The team has a good mix of young and experienced staff.
ex.zh: 團隊裡年輕和資深員工的組合很好。

ex.en: I bought a cake mix at the supermarket.
ex.zh: 我在超市買了一包蛋糕預拌粉。

ex.en: I am charged with an important mission.
ex.zh: 我肩負一項重要任務。

ex.en: Who picked you for this mission?
ex.zh: 誰選你來執行這個任務的？

ex.en: With their cooperation, the mission had been successfully finished.
ex.zh: 在他們的默契合作下，任務順利完成了。

ex.en: Our mission is to make healthy food affordable for everyone.
ex.zh: 我們的使命是讓每個人都吃得起健康的食物。

ex.en: Every employee should know the company's mission statement.
ex.zh: 每位員工都應該了解公司的使命宣言。

ex.en: A trade mission from Japan visited our factory.
ex.zh: 一個日本貿易代表團參觀了我們的工廠。

ex.en: She joined a diplomatic mission to Europe.
ex.zh: 她加入了前往歐洲的外交使節團。

ex.en: What is the minimum wage in Georgia?
ex.zh: 請問喬治亞州的最低工資是多少？

ex.en: Today's minimum temperature was 3 °C.
ex.zh: 今天的最低氣溫是攝氏三度。

ex.en: Keep costs to a minimum.
ex.zh: 把成本壓到最低。

ex.en: You need a minimum of three years' experience.
ex.zh: 你至少需要三年經驗。

ex.en: Add a little more milk to my tea, please.
ex.zh: 請在我的茶裡再加點牛奶。

ex.en: I bought a few eggs and a little milk.
ex.zh: 我買了幾顆蛋和一點牛奶。

ex.en: Ziri went to his fridge to grab some milk.
ex.zh: 齊里走到冰箱前拿牛奶。

ex.en: He could be found at 6 o'clock every morning in the barn, milking the cows.
ex.zh: 每天早上六點都可以在牛棚裡看到他在擠牛奶。

ex.en: The farmer milks the cows twice a day.
ex.zh: 農夫每天擠兩次牛奶。

ex.en: Only a minority of employees work from home.
ex.zh: 只有少數員工在家工作。

ex.en: A small minority of customers complained about the price.
ex.zh: 只有一小部分顧客抱怨價格。

ex.en: The law protects the rights of minorities.
ex.zh: 這項法律保障少數族群的權利。

ex.en: Minority groups are often underrepresented in management.
ex.zh: 少數族群在管理階層中的比例往往偏低。

ex.en: He played a minor part in the play.
ex.zh: 他在劇中演一個小角色。

ex.en: A couple of flights were delayed on account of a minor accident.
ex.zh: 因為一起小事故，有幾班航班延誤了。

ex.en: She's still a minor.
ex.zh: 她還未成年。

ex.en: I'm a minor.
ex.zh: 我未成年。

ex.en: She majored in business and minored in English.
ex.zh: 她主修商業，副修英文。

ex.en: I'm minoring in economics this year.
ex.zh: 我今年副修經濟學。

ex.en: She stopped before the mirror to admire herself.
ex.zh: 她在鏡子前停下來欣賞自己。

ex.en: Tom looked at his reflection in the mirror.
ex.zh: 湯姆看著鏡中的自己。

ex.en: He picked up a mirror and examined his tongue.
ex.zh: 他拿起一面鏡子仔細看自己的舌頭。

ex.en: The novel mirrors the author's own life.
ex.zh: 這本小說反映了作者自己的人生。

ex.en: Sales trends mirror changes in consumer habits.
ex.zh: 銷售趨勢反映了消費習慣的改變。

ex.en: As everyone knows, air is a mixture of gases.
ex.zh: 眾所皆知，空氣是多種氣體的混合物。

ex.en: Blend the mixture together until it is smooth.
ex.zh: 把混合物攪拌到滑順為止。

ex.en: Every opinion is a mixture of truth and error.
ex.zh: 任何意見都是事實與錯誤的混合。

ex.en: The bar-tailed godwit migrates from Alaska to New Zealand.
ex.zh: 斑尾鷸從阿拉斯加遷徙到紐西蘭。

ex.en: The swallows are migrating.
ex.zh: 燕子正在遷徙。

ex.en: Many birds migrate south for the winter.
ex.zh: 許多鳥會往南遷徙過冬。

ex.en: Many young people migrate to cities to find work.
ex.zh: 許多年輕人移居城市找工作。

ex.en: His family migrated to Canada in the 1990s.
ex.zh: 他家在 1990 年代移民到加拿大。

ex.en: We plan to migrate our data to the cloud.
ex.zh: 我們計畫把資料轉移到雲端。

ex.en: The company migrated to a new email system.
ex.zh: 公司換到了新的電子郵件系統。

ex.en: The screw is five millimeters long.
ex.zh: 這顆螺絲長五毫米。

ex.en: Rainfall was measured in millimeters.
ex.zh: 降雨量以毫米為單位測量。

ex.en: The miners work deep underground every day.
ex.zh: 礦工每天都在地底深處工作。

ex.en: His grandfather was a coal miner.
ex.zh: 他的祖父是煤礦工人。

ex.en: She collects miniature cars.
ex.zh: 她收集迷你小汽車。

ex.en: The architect showed us a miniature model of the building.
ex.zh: 建築師給我們看大樓的縮小模型。

ex.en: The museum displays miniatures of famous ships.
ex.zh: 博物館展示著名船艦的縮小模型。

ex.en: The park is like a city in miniature.
ex.zh: 這座公園就像一個縮小版的城市。

ex.en: If you see a mistake, then please correct it.
ex.zh: 如果你發現有錯的話請幫忙改正。

ex.en: Careful as he was, he made an unexpected mistake.
ex.zh: 他雖然很小心，還是犯了意想不到的錯。

ex.en: You continue making the same mistakes time after time.
ex.zh: 你一次又一次犯同樣的錯。

mistake.zh: （mistake A for B）把 A 誤認為 B

ex.en: I didn't greet you because I mistook you for somebody else.
ex.zh: 我把你認成了別人，所以才沒有和你打招呼。

ex.en: You may have mistaken Jane for his sister.
ex.zh: 你可能把珍誤認成他妹妹了。

ex.en: His illness caused her great misery.
ex.zh: 他的病使她非常傷心。

ex.en: The war brought misery to millions of people.
ex.zh: 戰爭給數百萬人帶來痛苦。

ex.en: The boy miraculously survived the fall.
ex.zh: 那個男孩奇蹟般地在墜落中存活下來。

ex.en: Miraculously, nobody was hurt in the crash.
ex.zh: 奇蹟般地，車禍中沒有人受傷。

ex.en: He likes mischief.
ex.zh: 他喜歡惡作劇。

ex.en: The little boy had a look of mischief in his eyes.
ex.zh: 那個小男孩眼裡閃著淘氣的神色。

ex.en: The twins are always up to mischief.
ex.zh: 這對雙胞胎總是在搞惡作劇。

mingle.zh: （在社交場合）與人交際、打成一片

ex.en: At the party, she mingled with the guests and made new friends.
ex.zh: 派對上，她和賓客們聊天交流，交到了新朋友。

ex.en: New students are encouraged to mingle during the welcome lunch.
ex.zh: 迎新午餐時，學校鼓勵新生多多和大家互動。

ex.en: The smell of coffee mingled with the scent of fresh bread.
ex.zh: 咖啡香和剛出爐麵包的香味交織在一起。

ex.en: Joy and sadness mingled in her heart on graduation day.
ex.zh: 畢業那天，她心中悲喜交加。

ex.en: As soon as you start misbehaving, Father Christmas will not come to see you.
ex.zh: 你只要一不乖，聖誕老公公就不會來看你了。

ex.en: The kids always misbehave when their parents aren't around.
ex.zh: 父母不在的時候，孩子們總是不守規矩。

ex.en: The news reported that the politician had a mistress for years.
ex.zh: 新聞報導那位政治人物多年來一直有個情婦。

ex.en: In the drama, the wife finds out about her husband's mistress.
ex.zh: 在這部連續劇裡，妻子發現了丈夫的情婦。

ex.en: The dog ran happily to greet its mistress at the door.
ex.zh: 狗狗開心地跑到門口迎接女主人。

ex.en: She was the mistress of a large house with many servants.
ex.zh: 她是一棟大宅的女主人，有許多僕人。

ex.en: Social media can spread misinformation very quickly.
ex.zh: 社群媒體可能讓錯誤資訊迅速散播。

ex.en: The government launched a campaign against health misinformation.
ex.zh: 政府發起了打擊健康錯誤資訊的宣導活動。

ex.en: The Foreign Minister said that war was inevitable.
ex.zh: 外交部長說戰爭無可避免。

ex.en: He is the prime minister of this country.
ex.zh: 他是這個國家的總理。

ex.en: This is the house in which the prime minister lives.
ex.zh: 這是總理住的房子。

ex.en: The minister gave a short speech at the wedding.
ex.zh: 牧師在婚禮上簡短致詞。

ex.en: Her father is a church minister.
ex.zh: 她父親是教會的牧師。

ex.en: The investigation found no evidence of misconduct.
ex.zh: 調查未發現不當行為的證據。

ex.en: Serious misconduct may lead to disciplinary action.
ex.zh: 嚴重失職可能導致懲處。

ex.en: The microprocessor controls the device's main functions.
ex.zh: 微處理器控制這台裝置的主要功能。

ex.en: A faster microprocessor improved the machine's performance.
ex.zh: 更快速的微處理器提升了機器的效能。

ex.en: The family rented a minivan for the weekend trip.
ex.zh: 這家人租了一輛廂型休旅車度週末。

ex.en: A minivan can carry the team"s equipment and six passengers.
ex.zh: 廂型休旅車可以載運團隊裝備和六名乘客。

ex.en: Drinks from the minibar will be added to your bill.
ex.zh: 迷你吧的飲料會加到你的帳單上。

ex.en: I took a bottle of water from the minibar.
ex.zh: 我從迷你吧拿了一瓶水。

ex.en: Hurry up, or you will miss the last train.
ex.zh: 再不快點你就要趕不上末班車了。

ex.en: Start at once, or you will miss the bus.
ex.zh: 馬上出發，不然你會錯過公車。

ex.en: She was worried that she might miss the train.
ex.zh: 她擔心她趕不上火車。

ex.en: We shall all miss you when you go away.
ex.zh: 你走了，我們都會想你的。

ex.en: I will badly miss you if you leave Japan.
ex.zh: 如果你離開日本，我會非常想你的。

ex.en: There must be some misunderstanding between us.
ex.zh: 我們之間肯定有誤會。

ex.en: In order to avoid misunderstandings, they went through the contract again.
ex.zh: 為了避免誤解，他們又把合約看了一遍。

ex.en: It's all just a big misunderstanding.
ex.zh: 這全是一場大誤會。

ex.en: Launching the app was a major milestone for the team.
ex.zh: 推出這個 App 是團隊的重大里程碑。

ex.en: Turning 18 is an important milestone.
ex.zh: 滿 18 歲是人生的重要階段。

ex.en: We took steps to mitigate the risk.
ex.zh: 我們採取了措施來降低風險。

ex.en: Trees can help mitigate the effects of heat.
ex.zh: 樹木可以幫助緩解炎熱的影響。

ex.en: Who is taking the minutes today?
ex.zh: 今天誰負責做會議紀錄？

ex.en: I'll send the minutes of the meeting to everyone.
ex.zh: 我會把會議紀錄寄給大家。

ex.en: It is about ten minutes' walk to the station.
ex.zh: 從這裡走到車站大約十分鐘。

ex.en: I think we had better wait another thirty minutes.
ex.zh: 我想我們還是再多等三十分鐘吧。
